name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Standard terms for a mutual NDA allowing both parties to share confidential information for a defined purpose, with reciprocal protections.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
description: Cover page template for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, to be completed and signed by both parties alongside the Standard Terms.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Comprehensive agreement governing access to and use of a cloud-based software product, including subscription terms, data privacy, payment, and liability.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement for early-access product design partnerships, governing feedback, product improvement rights, confidentiality, and IP ownership.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Defines uptime and response time commitments for a cloud service, including how service credits are calculated and claimed.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Framework agreement for professional services engagements including SOW-based delivery, IP assignment, payment terms, and indemnification.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: GDPR-compliant agreement governing how a service provider processes personal data on behalf of a customer, including SCCs and UK addendum.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Standard terms for business partnerships including mutual obligations, trademark licensing, payment, confidentiality, and indemnification.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Agreement governing on-premise software licensing including installation rights, restrictions, warranties, support, and payment terms.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Short-term agreement allowing a customer to evaluate a product during a defined pilot period before committing to a definitive agreement.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA-compliant agreement governing a service provider's handling of Protected Health Information on behalf of a covered entity.

name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum to a cloud service or software agreement covering AI-specific terms including model training restrictions, input/output ownership, and AI disclaimers.
